hooks.name: Check docs are updated
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to update docs, skills, steering and instruction files whenever a change lands, per the project's documentation-sync contract.

action.prompt: Before finishing: if this turn changed application code, schema, dependencies, deployment/hosting config, or any architectural decision, the project documentation must be updated in the same turn. Consult the `docs-sync` skill for the concern-to-file mapping and update every affected file: docs/*.md, .kiro/skills/**, .kiro/steering/**, and .github/copilot-instructions.md plus .github/instructions/**. If nothing documentation-relevant changed (a question was answered, a file was only read, a typo was fixed), this is a no-op: say nothing and stop.
